Priya Sharma: @here heads-up: we9re changing the default embeddings model and vector size in SDK v4.1. This affects embeddings endpoints and docs. Please read migration notes: https://intranet.redwood.local/docs/guides/embeddings-v2-migration :sparkles:
Marcus Lee: Quick Q 1  what9s the new default and why change now?
Priya Sharma: New default: redwood-embed-1536 (was redwood-embed-1024). Motivations: better semantic quality, unified dims across multimodal pipelines, and faster quantized paths on latest runtimes.
Docs-bot: New pages published: /docs/guides/embeddings-v2-migration, /docs/reference/embeddings. Also added an FAQ and bulk-migrate script.
Anna Ramos: Will this break existing vectors in customer DBs? We need clear guidance for CS and Solutions.
Priya Sharma: Existing vectors remain valid but are not compatible by shape with the new model. We recommend: either continue serving with redwood-embed-1024 (legacy) for up to 9 months, or run a bulk-reindex using our migration tool which maps old vectors -> new vectors with an optional hybrid index step. Docs include example reindex scripts for Postgres + Pinecone.
CS: Can we surface customers who rely on embeddings heavily? Need to reach out to any >10k vector index size users before rollout.
Priya Sharma: Yes 13 Console -> Admin -> API Usage -> Embeddings shows volume by customer and model version. We'll provide a weekly CSV to CS with candidate customers.
Eng-ML: Runtime notes: runtime supports both dims concurrently but there9s a memory tax on GPU for keeping two quantized profiles. We recommend rolling canaries and to enable auto-eviction for the cache during the migration window.
Legal-bot: Heads-up: any customer-facing SDK name change or license update? If we rename model strings in docs we need brief legal review.
Priya Sharma: No license changes. We are adding a new model alias mapping ("latest-embed" -> "redwood-embed-1536") and documenting it. Legal review requested for the alias wording.
Marcus Lee: Timeline?
Priya Sharma: Rollout plan:
- docs + SDK guides published: 2026-07-01
- canary traffic for redwood-embed-1536: 2026-07-08 (opt-in)
- hosted default flip: 2026-08-01 (legacy model available for 9 months)
- Dedicated/Private: legacy model served for 12 months with opt-in to flip earlier
Action items:
- docs: add reindex scripts and FAQ (PR in #docs)
- eng-ml: confirm runtime memory test and eviction policy (PR #909)
- cs: run initial export and prepare outreach template for >10k vectors
- legal: review alias wording
Priya Sharma: If anyone has blockers or runs into edge-cases with multimodal pipelines, ping me directly. We'll host a migration walkthrough next week; calendar invite going out. Thanks everyone :rocket:
